| Michigan prediction-market shutdown | @DegenTracker_ 2026-11-18 14:43Z: Michigan shuts down sports betting on Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood and Coinbase; Polymarket must close every Michigan user's open bets by Nov 25 | ORACLE (its instrument venues), PROME | Regulator order not read. Bears on venue access for ORACLE's reads; not a market-odds claim. combo:none |
| Unnamed Fed official | @PolymarketMoney 2026-11-18 13:33Z: 'Fed official warns more aggressive action is needed as inflation heads in the wrong direction' | HENRY, BOND, ORACLE | Official NOT NAMED. WALTER's search finds Kansas City Fed's Schmid on Nov 15 ('moving in the wrong direction', did not call for hikes, not a 2026 voter) and Philadelphia Fed's Paulson ('move more aggressively if inflation worsens'); which one the post means is UNKNOWN. December pricing stays ORACLE's (WQ-671) |
| San Francisco flooding | @Breaking911 2026-11-18 22:20Z; video still dated Nov 18, 2026, ABC7, Mission District streets flooded | AEOLUS | Card 005 carried El Nino waves and California coastal flooding. combo:AEOLUS/enso |

Not carried: @Reuters 11/18 05:45Z LPG tanker crew abandoned ship after a projectile strike in Hormuz is TARA GAS of 11/17 (cards 20261118-001 and -006).

No directed ask.
